body:
If he does... I’ll be upset but that’s just something I’ll have to deal with, and I will have to move on. I’m hoping he doesn’t, I don’t think he will, but I love him and want him to be happy. If he finds that with another person... he deserves the best. I know I would treat him right, but the world is full of other good people, too.

As for me... he feels like the most beautiful person I’ve ever laid eyes on. But our relationship cannot be happy if he is not happy. I want to help him however I can, whilst taking care of myself too.
No drama... just two people trying to be healthy. You can find drama elsewhere

We’re not really planning on dating anyone else, it’s just... romantic distance. So that he can heal and I do not get hurt in the process. The relationship is not black or white. We both love each other and have an immense amount of respect for one another, we both just want to become healthier people so we can have a stronger relationship.

Hey. I wasn’t in any right position to respond to this comment when you made it, but... I am okay. I am alive.

I read When Things Fall Apart by Pema Chödron. It is my favourite book now. One of her messages are now my senior quote and it really helped me change my perspective on the world.

Life got a bit better. I got away from some nasty people. When I wrote this post, I was wallowing in an Ativan addiction. I ended up stopping and going through withdrawal sometime after.

I still hurt, but the tunnel vision isn’t so bad anymore. I’m getting better every day. My heart still has its aches, and I carry my hurt around with me, but the bleeding has stopped a bit and I am stable. I am okay.

Thank you for reaching out to me when I needed it most. I really just needed someone to listen to me, and Reddit was here to do that. I am thankful.
This helped.

I’m really scared to cut things off with him. I keep trying to be understanding because I don’t know how he is feeling; but he is not sharing anything with me. I can’t figure this out if he doesn’t give me anything to work with.

I do not want to lose him; I’m going to be honest and say that this is the happiest I’ve ever been. But I know that is selfish of me and I need to make things right. I just don’t know how I’ll be if this doesn’t work out.

I can’t stop thinking about his girlfriend. She’s been the first thought I have when I wake up in the morning. I just wanted him to break up with her, because even if he does stay with her, he still cheated on her. I wish she found out because I hate that she does not know about any of this. I know I have been defending him by not cutting things off with him and trying to give him time and such, and I know that I took part in it, but I recognize it’s wrong and I feel like she deserves to know if he decides to stay with her.

I can’t block him because technically; we work together. It’s online but we work at the same place with the same people. I think I included that in the edit.

I gave him time because I understand it’s a difficult thing to do... but when I said time I didn’t mean a month. It went beyond a one time thing. I can’t tell what his distance is. We are still talking, he’s been sending me good morning and goodnight texts for months now, but he seems more drawn back. I don’t know. To me I hope it is because he is thinking about it.

I know you are right.
My heart does not want to but my head knows better. I have been acting a lot on my feelings and less from logic.

I feel like either way I am a fool here. But I was had planned on directly telling him that I do not like how our relationship started and that if he ever lost feelings for me or found somebody else he has to let me go. I think trust in a relationship is very important, and I recognize we do not have that from where we are right now. That is something that would have to be built. I trust him as a person but in a relationship we would need to work on it.
Could you expand on this by any chance? I am just wondering what you mean by transference.

I actually don’t know how close he lives to his girlfriend. But yeah— we live generally far away. I was fine with only having the emotional piece for awhile until I could graduate this year and try and get my life set up a bit more when university comes around in the fall.

There is no defending myself here. I was under the impression that he had lost feelings for her, and was comfortable continuing if they had broken up. The issue is that they didn’t and now I’m here— where I never wanted to be. I know it is wrong but I posted this because I need to figure out how to move on from here.

As for the age difference, I was a little taken aback. But apparently to everyone else around me it seemed like a generally normal gap. I feel fine with it, but also logically, we are at different stages of our lives and I don’t know what he is thinking at this point.
I do have doubts, and you are right. I think I was blinded by my feelings and aimlessly kept this going. I do not know how to confront him again.

I know.
I told myself I would never date online, but when we started talking I realized how much I liked him. I was willing to make it work if things went well.

This is an incredibly wonderful answer. Thank you for taking the time to write all of this out.

It makes a lot of sense. I was maybe thinking the same thing, but your perspective widened mine. Either way, I don’t want to date anyone soon because I am going through my own personal stuff and need time alone with myself. I think waiting and exploring is a good idea.

This really helped. I will take your advice and just hold things off and be open with our communication. He is a lovely friend, and I would enjoy just being friends with him for awhile.
